query.en: Create a 15-second 3D motion piece rendered in the browser with Three.js: a small procedural tropical island at golden hour. Animate ocean waves with a shader, palm trees swaying in the breeze and slow-drifting clouds. The camera starts high above the sea, glides down and arcs around the island, then settles on a calm wide shot as the title "Made of code." fades in and holds for two seconds. Stylized rather than photoreal: soft gradients, gentle toon shading and a warm sunset palette. Drive every movement from the timeline time so any moment replays exactly.
query.zh-CN: 用 Three.js 在浏览器里制作一段 15 秒的 3D 动效：黄昏时分一座程序生成的热带小岛。用着色器让海浪起伏，棕榈树随风摇摆，云朵缓缓飘动。镜头从海面高空出发，滑落后绕小岛转一道弧线，最后停在平静的远景上，标题“Made of code.”渐显并停留两秒。风格化而非写实：柔和渐变、轻卡通光影、温暖的日落色调。所有运动都由时间轴驱动，任意时刻都能精确重放。
